subject: Opioid Settlement Fund and Polystyrene Variances
overview: The board reviewed community feedback on the allocation of $1.5 million in opioid settlement funds and granted temporary polystyrene ban variances to several local businesses. Discussion also focused on the logistics of the fall flu and COVID-19 vaccination campaign.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the September 19, 2023, meeting.

items.title: Opioid Settlement Fund Update
items.summary: Penny Funaiole presented survey data and a 15-year plan for $1.5 million in opioid settlement funds, highlighting community support for harm reduction and recovery services. The board reviewed the proposed funding buckets ahead of a planned November submission to the City Council.

items.title: Polystyrene Ban Variances
items.summary: Approved temporary variances for the polystyrene ban for several local establishments, including Rose’s Chinese Restaurant, Amor Pizza, and the Medford Nursing and Rehab center. The deferments allow businesses to exhaust existing supplies through late 2023 or early 2024.

items.title: Vaccination Clinic Update
items.summary: Public health staff updated the board on the completion of 300 flu shots and the procurement of 200 private COVID-19 vaccine doses for upcoming clinics. The board determined that the 15-minute observation period after COVID-19 vaccination will be optional except for first-time recipients or those with a history of reactions.
